prompt: Mean of n observations is x̄. The 1st is increased by 1, 2nd by 2, …, nth by n. New mean is?

subject: Mathematics
topic: Median of ungrouped and grouped data
prompt: Grouped data has open-ended classes (e.g. 'below 10', '50 and above'). Which measure can still be found?
explain: Median needs only cumulative frequencies, so it can be found if the median class is closed; mean and SD need all class marks.
